source.notes: arch-010 (UT causal triangular transform). PaTH: per-chunk strictly-lower Householder transform T_mat producing corrected operands (A_local, q', k'), then cross-chunk scores with progressive q' correction, plus the FoX-style cumulative-gate bias gc_i − gc_j, softmax, @v. The transform is a data-dependent strictly-causal solve, NOT a per-token projection (sweep verdict: no projection-only equivalence). Verified against fla/ops/path_attn/naive.py @ 864a87f6 (single-chunk case). Layer module: architectures/path_attention.py.
